document.title: Living in high-rise buildings
document.question:
In many cities, more and more people live in high-rise apartment buildings. Some think this is the only practical way to house a growing urban population, while others believe it harms people’s quality of life.

Do the advantages of living in high-rise buildings outweigh the disadvantages?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
